question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in bold in the following sentence.**

The headless monster winked at her from eyes embedded in __**pudgy**__ shoulders.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 i.e. thick-bodied.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The meaning of the bold word **pudgy** is (of a person or part of their body) rather fat.( गोलमटोल)
 
• **Thick**-**bodied** means having a thick body.( मोटा शरीर)
